observations.body: Chronicles opens with a compressed chain from Adam to Noah and then names Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
observations.label: Chronicles places Noah between Adam and his sons: action

observations.body: The long flood narrative is reduced to Noah’s place in ancestral succession.
observations.label: Chronicles places Noah between Adam and his sons: response

payload.posture: Read 1 Chronicles 1:1–4 as ancestry and later memory evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The genealogy establishes placement, not a summary judgment about Noah’s life.
